title: Ivo and the Well
author: D. M. Montrose
blurb: August Underhill, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
